name: list
description: Collects a value from every matching log in emission order, keeping duplicates. Exists for append-only state (upgrade history, batch commitments, registered hashes) where V1 used an `event` handler with `add` only and the order and repetition carry meaning. Replaces the V1 `event` handler used with `add` and no `remove`.
input: The result of a `logs` fetch: decoded logs `[{ event, blockNumber, logIndex, args }]` in chain order.

key.description: Name of the event argument to collect from each matching log.

add.description: Rules selecting the logs to collect from.

when.description: Optional filter: only logs where `args[arg]` equals `equals` (inverted by `negate`).

equals.description: Literal to compare against, any JSON value.

output: Array of `args[key]` for every matching log, in chain order, duplicates kept.
